stories.title: BOJ September Minutes Show Debate Over Pace of Rate Hikes
stories.summary: Minutes from the Bank of Japan's September meeting show board members debated whether more rate hikes are needed. They also discussed room for a faster pace of tightening. The minutes give a view into the central bank's internal debate ahead of future decisions.
stories.whyItMatters: BOJ rate policy moves the yen and Japanese stocks, and it shifts global rate differentials that markets track closely.
whatToWatch: Future BOJ meetings for signs the debated faster pace takes hold.
Yen and Japanese equity reaction in the days ahead.
questions: Which board members pushed for a faster hike pace, and why?
How soon could the BOJ act on this debate?

sources.title: BOJ debated need for more rate hikes, scope for faster move, September minutes show

stories.title: Samsara CTO John Bicket Sells $11.3 Million in Company Stock
stories.summary: Samsara's chief technology officer, John Bicket, sold $11.3 million of company stock, Investing.com reported. The report gives the dollar value of the sale but no further detail on the reason or the trading plan behind it.
stories.whyItMatters: Large insider sales can draw investor scrutiny, even when they reflect routine diversification rather than a view on the company.
whatToWatch: Any SEC filing detail on whether the sale was part of a pre-set trading plan.
Whether other Samsara insiders report sales of their own.
questions: Was this sale part of a 10b5-1 trading plan?
How much of his Samsara stake does Bicket still hold?
